shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
shipping.summary: Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days ($5.99, or FREE on orders over $50). Express shipping takes 1–2 business days ($14.99).
details: Standard shipping: 3–5 business days ($5.99 flat rate).
Free standard shipping automatically applies on all orders totaling $50.00 or more.
Express expedited shipping: 1–2 business days ($14.99 flat rate).
Orders placed before 2:00 PM EST ship the same business day.
Tracking number and carrier link are emailed within 24 hours of dispatch.
International shipping: 7–14 business days (calculated at checkout based on destination).
We ship via USPS, FedEx, and UPS.

returns.title: Returns & Refund Policy
returns.summary: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return window for unworn items in original packaging. Refunds are credited back to the original payment method within 5–7 business days.
details: 30-day return window from the delivery date for unused, unwashed items in original packaging with tags attached.
Refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5–7 business days after our warehouse inspects the returned item.
Prepaid return shipping labels are provided for defective, damaged, or incorrect items.
Standard returns for change of mind incur a $4.99 return shipping fee deducted from the refund.
Final sale items, hygiene items (face masks, ear tips), and gift cards are non-refundable.

payment.title: Accepted Payment Methods & Security
payment.summary: We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), Stripe, Apple Pay, and Google Pay with 256-bit SSL encryption.
details: Accepted cards: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover.
Digital wallets: Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Stripe Checkout.
All transactions are secured with industry-standard 256-bit SSL encryption and PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance.
We do not store complete credit card numbers on our servers.
Installment payment options (Buy Now, Pay Later) are available via Stripe Klarna/Afterpay at checkout.

warranty.title: Product Warranty & Guarantee
warranty.summary: All electronics, watches, and hardware carry a 1-year limited manufacturer warranty against manufacturing defects. Apparel and accessories include a 90-day craftmanship guarantee.
details: 1-year manufacturer warranty covers electronics, smart watches, headphones, and chargers for functional defects.
Apparel, bags, and sunglasses carry a 90-day guarantee against stitching and material defects.
Warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, cosmetic scratches, water damage exceeding product IP rating, or accidental drops.
To file a warranty claim, submit your order number and photos of the defect to support@shoptrendz.com.

support.title: Customer Support & Contact
support.summary: Customer support is available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST via email at support@shoptrendz.com and live chat.
details: Email: support@shoptrendz.com (replies within 24 hours on business days).
Live Chat: Available on website 24/7 with ShopBuddy AI and live human escalation during business hours.
Business hours: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST.
Headquarters: 100 Commerce Boulevard, Suite 400, New York, NY 10001.
